name: Customer Behavior Analytics
description: Transactional data cleaned in Power Query and modeled in DAX into KPI metrics with cross-filtering across segments, revenue, and subscriptions.
builtOn: Transactional extract shaped in Power Query, measures in DAX
answers: Which age groups and categories drive revenue, not just volume?
Do subscribers spend differently from one-off buyers?
How do shipping choice and gender shift the average basket?

name: Weather & Air Quality Monitor
source: Live Weather and Air Quality Analytics Platform
description: Five-page operational report over a 4-layer S3 lake and 6 Athena views: catalog KPIs, weather trends, air-quality analysis down to PM2.5 and PM10, country-level city comparison, and a pipeline page tracking 64 API runs and 88 data-quality checks.
audience: Environmental analysts & the pipeline's own operators
builtOn: Hourly API ingest into a 4-layer S3 lake, read through 6 Athena views
answers: Which of the 8 cities has the worst air quality, and by how far?
How do temperature, humidity, wind and rainfall compare across countries?
Did last night's ingest run clean, or did a check fail?

name: California Wildfire Analysis
description: County-level view of burned acreage and seasonality, backed by a 7-year ETL that enriches fire records with weather API features.
builtOn: Seven years of fire records joined to weather APIs in PostgreSQL
answers: Which counties lose the most acreage, and is that changing?
When in the year does fire risk actually peak?
How closely does weather track fire activity?

name: Amazon Prime Content Analytics
source: Amazon Prime Movies & TV Shows Analytics Dashboard
description: Explores Amazon Prime Video's catalog across 1920–2021: an area chart of titles added per release year split Movie versus TV Show, a donut showing the 80.8% / 19.2% type mix, bar charts by content rating and by genre, a world map of origin country, and KPI cards for 9,655 titles, 25 ratings, genres and directors.
views: Titles by release year (Movie vs TV)
builtOn: 9,655-title catalogue shaped in Power Query, measures in DAX
answers: How fast is the catalogue growing, and is it tilting to film or TV?
Which genres and content ratings dominate the library?
Where in the world does the catalogue come from?

name: Airport Operations KPIs
description: Two pages over a million analytical flights: on-time performance against an 85% SLA target, then a breakdown of where the delays actually come from — by cause, by airport and by day of the week.
builtOn: Python ETL over a hybrid MySQL + MongoDB schema, modelled in Power BI
answers: Are we hitting the 85% on-time target, and by how much are we missing it?
Is any carrier meeting the target, or is the gap across the board?
What is causing the delays, and which airports suffer worst?

name: Data Science Salaries Explorer
description: Seven linked views over global data-science compensation: salary by experience level and employment type, company-size and seniority mixes, a Mapbox map of average salary by country, a job-title salary table down to experience level, and the top 10 employee residences — all driven by location and job-title filters.
builtOn: Global salary survey modelled in Tableau with a Mapbox geography layer
answers: What does this role pay at my experience level?
Which countries pay most, and where are these people based?
Is the market senior-heavy, full-time, and at large companies?
